findings.title: Nobody reads message target
findings.message: message source publishes to message target, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.

fix.label: Add a consumer…

findings.title: secret source reads secrets without an identity
findings.message: secret source reads secrets from secret target, but the diagram doesn't say what it signs in as. With an IAM role, it gets in with no stored credential to leak or rotate.
